ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to make lead source field read only for system lead
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( LeadSource ),!ISNEW(), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.UnicaIntegrationUserName)), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead', OR(TEXT(Lead_Originator__c) = 'Unica', TEXT(Lead_Originator__c) = 'Adobe') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead source cannot be changed for system lead
